environment.runtime: Docker (redis:8.8.2, valkey/valkey:9.1.1, dragonflydb/dragonfly:v1.40.1); memtier_benchmark 2.5.1; RESP2, no TLS

protocol.processModel: Container per engine, network_mode host; Dragonfly 64 proactor threads on 64 physical cores, Redis and Valkey single-threaded I/O (default io-threads 1); 16 GiB maxmemory for all three
protocol.cacheState: Preloaded keyspace, 100% hit ratio on GET workloads; working sets sized below 50% of maxmemory; eviction flags set for parity of intent, never triggered
protocol.output: memtier_benchmark 2.5.1: ops/s, p50/p99/p99.9 latency, client CPU per 10 s pass; memory via INFO MEMORY and cgroup RSS delta
